post.summary: Signs in with a username or email and a password.

200.description: Signed in; sets the refresh cookie

post.summary: Signs out: revokes the session and clears the cookie.

204.description: Signed out; clears the refresh cookie

get.summary: Starts single sign-on: redirects to the identity provider.

parameters.name: redirect
parameters.description: Local path to open after signing in.

get.summary:
Completes single sign-on: verifies the provider's answer, signs the user
in, sets the refresh cookie and returns to the app. No token is put in the URL.

303.description: Redirect to /auth/callback, or to /login?error=… on failure

post.summary: Exchanges the refresh cookie for a new access token (and rotates the cookie).

200.description: Session renewed; rotates the refresh cookie

401.description: Missing, expired or revoked refresh cookie

get.summary: Shows an invitation to whoever holds its link.

post.summary: Accepts an invitation: the caller joins the team as a member.
Joins the team behind an enabled join link as a member.

get.summary: Returns the signed-in user with their teams and pending invitations.

patch.summary: Changes the signed-in user's display name.

put.summary: Replaces the signed-in user's picture with the request body.

requestBody.description: A PNG, JPEG, GIF or WebP image of at most 5 MB

delete.summary: Deletes a task. Any team member may.

404.description: `task_not_found`: no such task or not a member of its team

patch.summary: Edits a task's content. Any team member may.

404.description: `task_not_found`: no such task or not a member of its team

put.summary:
Moves a task between or within columns. With neither neighbour, the task
goes to the end of the column. Any team member may move any task.

400.description: `invalid_position`: a neighbour is not in the team and target column, or is the task itself

404.description: `task_not_found`: no such task or not a member of its team

post.summary: Creates a team. The caller becomes its first admin.

get.summary: Returns one of the caller's teams.

404.description: `team_not_found`: no such team or not a member

delete.summary: Deletes a team and everything in it (admin).

get.summary: Lists a team's open invitations (any member).

post.summary:
Invites someone by email (any member). When that email already has an
open invitation, its inviter and admins get it back; other members get
`already_invited`.

201.description: The invitation and its personal link

delete.summary: Revokes an invitation (its inviter or an admin).

403.description: Neither the inviter nor an admin

get.summary: Returns the team join link (any member).

post.summary: Regenerates, enables or disables the join link (admin).

get.summary: Lists the members of a team, admins first.

delete.summary:
Removes a member (admin) or leaves the team (own user id). When the last
member leaves, the team is deleted.

patch.summary: Promotes or demotes a member (admin). The last admin cannot be demoted.

get.summary: Lists the team's tasks, ordered by status column and position.

parameters.name: author
parameters.description: Only tasks written by this user.

parameters.name: meeting
parameters.description: Only tasks attached to this meeting.

200.description: The tasks, by status then position

404.description: `team_not_found`: no such team or not a member

get.summary: A user's picture. Visible to the user and to people sharing a team with them.
get.description: The URL changes with `pictureVersion`, so the bytes are cached as immutable.

get.summary:
Readiness: the database is reachable and every migration this binary knows
is applied. Migrations applied by a newer release are ignored, so pods of
the previous release stay ready during a rolling upgrade.

AuthConfig.description: Which sign-in methods the sign-in page offers.

passwordResetUrl.description: Shown as "Forgot password?" when set. Retro sends no email itself.

InvitationDto.description: An open invitation, as listed in team settings.

url.description:
Personal accept link (`/invite/{token}`) to share with the invitee.
Only for the inviter and admins (spec §6.1); `null` for other members.

InvitationPreviewDto.description: What `/invite/{token}` shows before the invitee answers.

alreadyMember.description: The caller already belongs to the team.

members.description: Up to six members; empty unless the invitation is open.

enabled.description: Whether opening the link lets people join.

url.description: Absolute URL of the link; absent if none was ever generated.

alreadyMember.description: The caller was a member before opening the link.

invitations.description: Open invitations sent to the user's email, newest first.

signInMethod.description: `sso` when the user has a linked identity, else `password`.

teams.description: Teams the user belongs to, by name.

afterId.description: The task the moved one should land directly after, if any.

beforeId.description:
The task the moved one should land directly before when `afterId` is
absent. With both, the task lands directly after `afterId`, and
`beforeId` must be below it.

status.description: The column to move the task to.

PendingInvitationDto.description: An open invitation addressed to the signed-in user (user menu, onboarding).

PersonDto.description: A user reduced to what other team members may see next to their avatar.

pictureVersion.description: Content hash of the uploaded picture; `null` when there is none.

type.description: URI reference identifying the problem type.

Role.description: A member's role in a team (spec §5.1).

SessionResponse.description: A new session: a short-lived access token (the refresh token is in a cookie).

position.description: Ordering key within the column; compare as plain strings.

TaskStatus.description: Where a task sits on the board (spec §9).

TeamDto.description: A team as seen by the caller.

TeamRefDto.description: A team reference: id and name only.

displayName.description: New display name; trimmed, 1 to 80 characters.

content.description: Rich text; sanitized by the server.

UserDto.description: A user as exposed by the API.

pictureVersion.description: Content hash of the uploaded picture; `null` when there is none.
